note: Typed against the two-component contract built 2026-08-10. The prior sidecar carried a single untestable spec on the retired component `mineral_royalty_cash_stream`, whose stated blocker was that no reserve-life model existed. The 424B4 SUMMARY RESERVE DATA is now locked into the fact ledger, so every spec below resolves against a locked field_id.

specs.derived_from: The first 10-Q reports net production above 67,255 Mcfe/d, implying a producing decline shallower than the 13.14%-13.75% band derived from the reserve report
specs.rationale: Cash Available for Distribution is the ledger-locked observable that carries production through to owner cash. The producing component caps sustainable CAFD at $42.0m (the cafd_run_rate_m judgment's allowed_range max, set by Q1 2026 annualised of $39.836m). A reported CAFD above that means volumes are holding up better than a 13.14%-13.75% producing decline allows, so the component is understated. Testable off the first 10-Q as a public company.

specs.derived_from: the FY2026 reserve report raises PV-10 above $500m against the $293.690m booked here
specs.rationale: PV-10 of $500m over the 206,473 MMcfe booked at 2025-12-31 is $0.00242m per MMcfe. Crossing it means the reserve report has revalued the book far above the $3.387/MMBtu SEC deck this contract is anchored to, which resets both the producing component's discount rate comparability and the NAV component's unit value. Testable off the FY2026 10-K reserve report.

specs.derived_from: PV-10 per Mcfe moves outside $1.00-$2.00 on the next SEC price deck, which would reset the unit value this component is built on
specs.rationale: The NAV component values non-producing volumes off the blended PV-10 unit value of $1.422 per Mcfe, haircut for timing. If the next SEC price deck moves that blended rate outside $1.00-$2.00 per Mcfe the component's anchor is gone, in either direction. Testable off the FY2026 10-K reserve report.

specs.derived_from: The FY2026 reserve report reclassifies these volumes to producing without a matching fall in the PDP decline rate, which would mean the partition double-counts
specs.rationale: The partition rests on 206,473 MMcfe of proved reserves split 178,544 producing / 27,930 non-producing. A total proved book below 150,000 MMcfe means either the non-producing volumes this component values have been written down, or they were reclassified into production while the producing component still assumes a 7.27-year life -- the double-count the partition exists to prevent. Testable off the FY2026 10-K reserve report.
